checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Face looks like the same woman, though the smile and face shape shift somewhat.

must.item: Natural blink and subtle breathing visible
must.why: Only four still frames. Eyes are open in all of them. No blink is captured.

must.item: Face does not morph, drift or develop asymmetry
must.why: By the late frames the face is noticeably wider and more asymmetric. The head tilts, the smile skews, and the face looks more mature and heavier than in the source.

must.item: Curly dark hair, sweater and park setting consistent
must.why: Hair, grey sweater and park are kept. The background becomes heavily blurred and cropped by the zoom.

must.item: Square framing and camera fixed, silent, about 5 s
must.why: The camera pushes in strongly, so the shoulders and background are cropped away. The user wanted a fixed camera. Square format and 5 s duration are correct.

faults.what: A large camera push-in crops the head and background. The final frame cuts off the top of the hair and shows almost no park.
The face gradually drifts from the source. The smile broadens, the head tilts and the features change, so it looks like a different expression and a slightly different person.
The agent added a camera push-in and a broad smile that the user did not ask for. The prompt only said to make a video.
The face and hair look slightly over-smoothed and AI-like in the zoomed frames.

summary: The clip is a 5 s square video of the same woman in the park with natural hair motion, but the strong push-in crops the frame and the face drifts into a broad smile and changes slightly.
